title: OCS Engineering skill
summary: Installed OCS skill defines units, axes, frames, datums, part boundaries, revision-bound mutations, readback geometry checks, verified save and computational handoff. Existing local source; user reported prior partial runtime success in earlier conversation.

title: 3D modeling implementation plan
summary: Prior project proposal identifies OCS as the interactive baseline, FreeCAD for constrained feature trees, code-CAD for scripted solids, raster plans, drawing conversion and verification routes. Used as existing project context, not as runtime evidence.

title: 3D reconstruction research report
summary: Prior repository report assesses image/depth reconstruction methods, source terms and prerequisites. This batch references it for scan-to-CAD transition context and does not repeat that research.

title: Domain and component research report
summary: Prior project report compares reusable component sources and downstream architecture/robotics domains. This batch uses it for source-library and assembly handoffs.

title: Architecture research index
summary: Existing architecture project source index and prior route context for building design. It is referenced as prior work, not newly web researched.

title: OpenCADStudio CAD harness findings
summary: Prior read-only OCS inspection documents API capabilities and evidence limits, with source receipts. This workflow map reuses the findings and does not claim new runtime execution.

title: OpenCADStudio README
summary: Local OCS source README lists supported drawing formats, MCP/automation entry point, solid commands and STEP AP203 export of mesh data. Local source was inspected in prior CAD research; this report registers that evidence.

title: OpenCADStudio MCP automation guide
summary: Local OCS guide describes stdio MCP and drawing inspection, mutation, measurements, audits and verified save. It supports application-level drawing workflow claims.

title: OpenCADStudio kernel body path note
summary: Local OCS design/implementation note describes supported kernel-body paths and history limitations; it does not establish STEP analytic-surface export.

title: OpenCADStudio STEP writer source
summary: Local Rust writer consumes mesh models and emits triangular planar faces in STEP closed-shell/manifold-solid structures. It supports the claim that this exporter produces faceted mesh-derived STEP geometry.

title: OpenCV Python camera calibration tutorial
summary: Official OpenCV tutorial maps known 3D object points to image points, detects/refines chessboard corners and uses calibrateCamera; square dimensions establish physical units.

title: OpenCV calibration module overview
summary: Official OpenCV reference describes camera calibration, pose estimation, calibration target correspondences and reprojection-error optimization. A planar homography relates points on a plane and does not recover depth.

title: OpenCV image processing feature detection
summary: Official API documents probabilistic HoughLinesP on binary images and returns line-segment endpoint coordinates in pixel space.

title: OpenCV structural analysis and shape descriptors
summary: Official API documents contours, curve lengths, bounding boxes and approxPolyDP; polygon simplification is bounded by a pixel-coordinate precision setting.

title: Tesseract command line usage
summary: Official Tesseract documentation shows TSV output with text, hierarchical page/block/line/word identifiers, pixel bounding boxes and confidence values.

title: Residential Floor Plan Recognition and Reconstruction
summary: CVPR 2021 paper proposes residential floor-plan recognition/reconstruction, including segmentation and vectorization; paper reports tests on floor-plan imagery and method-specific results.

title: Vectorizing Building Blueprints
summary: ACCV 2022 paper studies automatic vectorization of raster building blueprints and reviews primitive detection, floor-plan vectorization and structured reconstruction.

title: Raster-to-Graph floor-plan recognition
summary: Computer Graphics Forum paper describes a learned raster-floorplan framework that predicts wall junctions and segments as an ordered graph representation.

title: Coordinate transformations of engineering drawings for 3D reconstruction from orthographic views
summary: Journal article describes segmenting engineering drawing views, linking coordinates with intermediate 2.5D frames, and establishing coordinate constraints between views.

title: Automatic 3D CAD models reconstruction from 2D orthographic drawings
summary: Computers & Graphics 2023 paper describes matching projected edge features across views to create a 3D wireframe, then detecting loops/faces and trimming/stitching a watertight model; reported F-score is study-specific.

title: PlankAssembly: Robust 3D Reconstruction from Three Orthographic Views with Learnt Shape Programs
summary: ICCV 2023 paper proposes a transformer/shape-program mapping from three orthographic views to CAD models and evaluates noisy/incomplete views on a benchmark dataset.

title: FreeCAD Draft DXF documentation
summary: Official FreeCAD docs list DXF entity support for C++ and legacy importers, format/version conditions, and note that 3D ACIS SAT blobs in DXF are not currently read by FreeCAD.

title: FreeCAD Draft SVG documentation
summary: Official FreeCAD docs list supported SVG paths/shapes, flattening of Z on import, use of viewBox/physical dimensions, and 90-DPI fallback when physical size is absent.

title: FreeCAD Sketcher scripting
summary: Official FreeCAD docs show Python creation of Sketcher geometry and addition of geometric/dimensional constraints.

title: FreeCAD Part scripting
summary: Official FreeCAD docs describe Python access to OpenCASCADE B-rep vertices, edges, wires, faces, solids, compounds and boolean operations.

title: ezdxf documentation
summary: Official ezdxf docs identify it as Python software to create/read/modify/write DXF, state supported DXF revisions, MIT licence and core dependencies.

title: build123d operations
summary: Official build123d docs show extrusion of a 2D sketch/face into a 3D part and document Builder/Algebra operations over OCCT geometry.

title: build123d stable documentation
summary: Official build123d documentation for a Python parametric B-rep modeling framework over Open CASCADE; used as an implementation reference, not runtime result.

title: CadQuery documentation
summary: Official CadQuery documentation describes Python parametric CAD scripting and supported imports/exports; native Python source carries its parametric construction record.

title: OpenSCAD documentation
summary: Official OpenSCAD manual documents script-defined CSG, parameterization, 2D imports/extrusion, CLI use and mesh-oriented file exports.

title: 3D reconstruction workflow findings
summary: Existing project report records COLMAP/AliceVision/Meshroom photo-to-sparse/dense cloud and mesh routes, metric scaling from controls, and checks for camera coverage, reprojection, point clouds, mesh defects and withheld dimensions. Registered from the existing report; no current external page was reopened for this batch.

title: COLMAP source repository
summary: Existing report identifies COLMAP as an SfM/MVS tool with GUI, CLI, Python bindings and BSD-3-Clause/new BSD licensing. This record traces the proposed photo reconstruction operation to the upstream project; the repository was not reopened in this batch.

title: COLMAP CLI documentation
summary: Existing report records command-line stages for database, feature extraction/matching, mapping, dense reconstruction and exports. This trace supports the scripted handoff proposal; exact current CLI behavior was not reopened in this batch.
